idea: MineSafety Enterprise is an AI-powered safety intelligence platform for corporate HSE departments of large mining companies. It enables workers to verbally report hazards in Spanish/Portuguese via a mobile app, using AI to transcribe, classify, and route issues, and provides a dashboard for risk analysis.
selected_gap: gap-01: AI-Powered Voice-to-Text for Mining Field Reports in Spanish/Portuguese

decision: Proceed with customer discovery and pilot development, but validate demand before building full platform.
next_experiments: Interview 5 HSE managers at Latin American mining companies to assess priority and willingness to pay.
Collect sample field reports in Spanish/Portuguese to test transcription accuracy against existing tools.
Run a Wizard of Oz pilot with one mine using human transcriptions to validate workflow improvement.
kill_criteria: After 20 interviews, less than 30% rank this as a top-3 priority for safety improvement.
Transcription accuracy on mining-specific terms falls below 85% in field recordings.
No mine agrees to a paid trial or LOI within 3 months of first contact.
_iteration_one_liner: We enable mining companies to turn every field safety observation into an actionable risk insight using AI voice transcription in Spanish and Portuguese, preventing incidents before they happen.
